VI.description: TRUE when a request carries an Origin header that names another host than its Host header\3A the part of origin after "\3A//" is compared with host. A request without an Origin header (origin exists? FALSE) is never cross-origin. Used by RemoteVI Handle Connection.vi to answer a cross-origin WebSocket upgrade with 403 (docs\5Csecurity.md). Pure.

Control.description: TRUE when the request has an Origin header.
Value of the Origin header\2C e.g. http\3A//host\3A8088.
Value of the Host header\2C e.g. host\3A8088.

Node.outputs: match + rest of string:ms.match + rest of string

Indicator.description: TRUE when Origin is present and names another host than Host.
